label: Task-first UI story with a clear finish

source.attribution: Stack by Ramp — publicly shared Arcade example

review.method: Human visual review of actual extracted film frames; timestamps are sampled observations, not detected cut boundaries.

observedFrames.subject: Single oversized product name on restrained branded stage
Whole workspace with task prompt and active accent
A single task prompt and system response dominate
Large isolated clarification with two choices
Task setup or approval panel with prominent action
Compact confirmed completion with secondary actions
Wider workspace context with multiple connected modules

grammar.focalHierarchy: One readable primary interface object per beat; background context is subordinate.
grammar.framing: Wide for orientation, tight for consequential choice or result, medium/wide after completion.
grammar.pacing: Shorten context beats; give consequential controls and the confirmed outcome a readable hold.
grammar.transitionLogic: Change focal scale only when story subject or verified state changes; avoid arbitrary cuts.
grammar.cursorPolicy: Only one real source-timed cursor; do not draw a fake path or animate static cutouts as active.
grammar.stageStyle: Quiet neutral support stage; capture native product colors rather than copying reference brand styling.
grammar.finalState: A visible resolved state, not a generic feature montage.

neverTransfer: reference product names, copy, or logos
exact reference timestamps as product event times
